subject: Consolidate flight legs for Kestrel workshop — San Jose Sep 14-16
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, travel@kestrel.com
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidate flight legs for Kestrel workshop — San Jose Sep 14-16

Hey all,

Quick note on travel for the Kestrel on-site (Sep 14–16). We have a few delegates arriving from different hubs and the current itineraries create fragile connections for two people (Marcus + Vivek) with <60 minute layovers at SFO.

Goal: consolidate into the smallest number of arrival legs to minimize risk and door-to-door transfer cost. Ideally:
- Marcus: morning arrival (no later than 10:30am PT on Sep 14)
- Vivek: arrive same day, pref. within 90 minutes of Marcus so we can run a single shuttle

Attached: itinerary_proposal_v1.pdf — proposed swaps that reduce the tight connections but add one earlier flight for Marcus.

Can Kestrel travel desk pull up the alternative PNRs and confirm price difference + hold for 24 hours? Also note Marcus has a wheelchair assistance request and Vivek needs an aisle seat.

Thanks — I can approve minor fare differences up to $150.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Events Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@kestrel.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidate flight legs for Kestrel workshop — San Jose Sep 14-16

Hi Monica — thanks for the brief.

Quick summary of options after checking live inventory:

Option A (PNR ABC123) — aligns with your consolidation ask
- Marcus: UA 342, depart BOS 06:05 ET -> SFO 09:45 PT (1 stop, 1h10m layover in ORD)
- Vivek: UA 378, depart JFK 07:00 ET -> SFO 10:10 PT (nonstop)
- Pros: both arrive within 25 minutes of each other; single shuttle feasible
- Cons: Marcus leg has a short domestic connection in ORD (we can request protected connection)
- Fare diff vs current: +$98 per pax

Option B (PNR DEF456) — more conservative
- Marcus: AA 229, depart BOS 07:30 ET -> SFO 11:20 PT (nonstop)
- Vivek: AA 311, depart JFK 08:00 ET -> SFO 11:15 PT (1 stop)
- Pros: longer layovers, lower risk; Cons: staggered arrivals (1h apart), slightly higher fare for Vivek (+$165)

Attachments: itinerary_v2.pdf (detailed legs), booking_snapshot.png (inventory), and a small booking notes text file. I can place a 24-hr hold on both PNRs for your approval.

A couple of logistical asks:
- Shuttle can be held for 60–90 minutes after the first arrival; please confirm final pickup time so we can reserve the van.
- Marcus noted wheelchair assistance — we flagged it on both holds.

Tell me which option you prefer and I’ll secure the hold.

— Samantha
Samantha Lee
Corporate Travel Manager | Kestrel Travel Desk
samantha.lee@kestrel.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@kestrel.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidate flight legs for Kestrel workshop — San Jose Sep 14-16

Samantha — Option A works best operationally. Please place the 24-hour hold on PNR ABC123.

Couple of clarifications/asks:
- Marcus: confirm aisle seat request and wheelchair assistance flagged — he will need transfer assistance at ORD.
- Vivek: aisle seat please, can we upgrade him to Main Cabin Extra if available within the $150 delta?
- Shuttle: plan pickup at SFO arrivals (terminal to parking lot) at 10:45 PT if both land per Option A; if Marcus is delayed, we’d like a 30–60 minute grace window before cancelling.

Forwarding the PNR_ABC123.ics to add to calendars — please snapshot the final confirmation once ticketed.

Thanks — I’ll approve the +$98 fare for both if that secures the consolidated arrival.

— Monica

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@kestrel.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-29T12:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidate flight legs for Kestrel workshop — San Jose Sep 14-16

Thanks team — final confirmation: please ticket PNR ABC123 and add the following services before issuance:
- Wheelchair assistance for Marcus at BOS -> ORD -> SFO and transfer assistance at SFO arrivals
- Aisle seats for Marcus and Vivek; upgrade Vivek to Main Cabin Extra if it fits within the delta.
- Shuttle pickup at SFO 10:45 PT with 45-minute hold window (driver to call upon arrival)

Samantha, once ticketed please send the full ticket PDF and we’ll publish the calendar invites and the meeting logistics doc.

I’m fine approving the +$98 fare; if there are any changes >$150, loop me and Aditya.
